🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL, as supplied. Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive; Technology is the sole negative sector while Consumer Discretionary, Healthcare and Materials lead, a mixed confirmation rather than a uniform risk signal. Leadership: top five performers span 3 sectors—neither Narrow (≤2) nor Broad (≥4); style mixed / no clear leadership.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Consumer Discretionary leads on sector returns: GM (1W: +15.12% | 1M: +10.20%) and RCL (1W: +11.10% | 1M: +13.77%), both ABOVE TREND. Healthcare follows with LLY (1W: +11.31% | 1M: +23.28%) and GILD (1W: +9.38% | 1M: +15.72%), both ABOVE TREND; Materials is also strong, with PPG (1W: +8.06% | 1M: +14.19%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology is weakest: GOOGL (1W: -12.61% | 1M: -17.27%) and INTC (1W: -24.38% | 1M: -45.20%) are BELOW TREND. Communication is nearly flat on the week, with TTWO (1W: -6.64% | 1M: -6.61%) BELOW TREND and TMUS (1W: +6.76% | 1M: -3.27%) in RECOVERY; Energy is modestly positive at +0.41% for the week.

📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top five: GM (1W: +15.12% | 1M: +10.20%), LLY (1W: +11.31% | 1M: +23.28%), RCL (1W: +11.10% | 1M: +13.77%), GILD (1W: +9.38% | 1M: +15.72%) and PPG (1W: +8.06% | 1M: +14.19%), all ABOVE TREND. Leadership: concentrated in 3 sectors—Consumer Discretionary, Healthcare and Materials; neither Narrow nor Broad by the stated thresholds.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom five: NOW (1W: -33.87% | 1M: -23.69%), INTC (1W: -24.38% | 1M: -45.20%), GOOGL (1W: -12.61% | 1M: -17.27%), CAT (1W: -9.14% | 1M: -24.46%) and BA (1W: -8.92% | 1M: -10.78%), all BELOW TREND. Weakness is concentrated in Technology, with additional pressure in Industrials.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest weekly moves include GM (1W: +15.12% | 1M: +10.20%), LLY (1W: +11.31% | 1M: +23.28%) and RCL (1W: +11.10% | 1M: +13.77%), all ABOVE TREND. Divergences include TMUS (1W: +6.76% | 1M: -3.27%) in RECOVERY and SHOP (1W: -6.63% | 1M: +5.63%) in CORRECTION.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Weak, with the sector down 4.05% for the week and 6.51% for the month; constituent positive-count data was not supplied (24 stocks in the sector summary). NVDA (1W: -3.00% | 1M: -11.36%), META (1W: -4.30% | 1M: -15.28%) and GOOGL (1W: -12.61% | 1M: -17.27%) are BELOW TREND, while AAPL (1W: -0.89% | 1M: +4.33%) and MSFT (1W: -0.50% | 1M: +1.78%) are in CORRECTION.

8. Financials Outlook?
Positive but not leading, with the sector up 0.96% for the week and 4.15% for the month; constituent positive-count data was not supplied (20 stocks). JPM (1W: +1.65% | 1M: +1.66%), V (1W: +1.39% | 1M: +14.93%) and MA (1W: +2.31% | 1M: +16.18%) are all ABOVE TREND.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Strong, with the sector up 2.26% for the week and 10.22% for the month; constituent positive-count data was not supplied (17 stocks). LLY (1W: +11.31% | 1M: +23.28%) and GILD (1W: +9.38% | 1M: +15.72%) are ABOVE TREND, while UNH (1W: -2.66% | 1M: +11.44%) is in CORRECTION.

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Stay selective: relative strength is in Consumer Discretionary, Healthcare and Materials, while Technology is weak; reduce exposure to persistent Technology laggards only within mandate limits. Style mixed / no clear leadership: broad sector breadth contrasts with Tech weakness, and the leaders do not meet the stated Growth/Momentum or Value/Cyclical style triggers.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Monitor GD (1W: +6.65% | 1M: +12.53%) and CRH (1W: +6.97% | 1M: +11.15%), both ABOVE TREND, for follow-through after positive earnings and guidance headlines. BEARISH: Watch CAT (1W: -9.14% | 1M: -24.46%) and GOOGL (1W: -12.61% | 1M: -17.27%), both BELOW TREND, for continued weakness.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Healthcare (+2.26% 1W; +10.22% 1M) and Materials (+2.88% 1W; +9.05% 1M) have positive sector returns, with LLY (1W: +11.31% | 1M: +23.28%) and PPG (1W: +8.06% | 1M: +14.19%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Technology (-4.05% 1W; -6.51% 1M) remains weakest; its constituent positive-count breadth was not provided.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Absolute price levels were not supplied, so monitor trend confirmation instead: NVDA (1W: -3.00% | 1M: -11.36%) and GOOGL (1W: -12.61% | 1M: -17.27%), both BELOW TREND, for stabilization; AAPL (1W: -0.89% | 1M: +4.33%) in CORRECTION for a return to positive weekly performance. JPM (1W: +1.65% | 1M: +1.66%) remains ABOVE TREND; watch for continued positive weekly and monthly returns.

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
GD (+75): Q3 earnings lifted guidance as backlog reached a record; GD (1W: +6.65% | 1M: +12.53%) is ABOVE TREND, confirming the positive news. CRH (+75): Q3 update cited resilient revenue growth and a buyback; CRH (1W: +6.97% | 1M: +11.15%) is ABOVE TREND, also confirming the sentiment.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
CAT (-45): Price-target cut; CAT (1W: -9.14% | 1M: -24.46%) is BELOW TREND, confirming the negative tone. JPM (-35): Earnings-miss concerns; JPM (1W: +1.65% | 1M: +1.66%) is ABOVE TREND, diverging from the negative sentiment.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL regime, with style mixed / no clear leadership; breadth is 10/11 sectors positive and top-five leadership spans 3 sectors. GM (1W: +15.12% | 1M: +10.20%) and LLY (1W: +11.31% | 1M: +23.28%) are showing relative strength, both ABOVE TREND. Monitor Technology weakness and JPM’s negative news divergence from its ABOVE TREND price action (1W: +1.65% | 1M: +1.66%).
